joints.handle_description: No handle; pinch the lid's free front edge (8 mm thick, slight overhang past the base); lid hinged at the rear, free edge rises.
joints.height_concern: Edge only ~0.015 m above object base; far below 0.25 m if on floor

object_note: Thin closed lid sits directly on the base; lower fingertip must slip under the small front overhang. Red dot on the right edge is mesh, not a marker.
